grades.lower_bound_mechanism: powers-of-2 division + weighted-multigraph tree-component bipartition (rank pairing)
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: subset-sum pigeonhole gap + common-refinement equal-pairing overlay
grades.notes: Complete all-n proof. Reduction proved by backward induction that claiming value equals alternating sum D. Lower bound: Liu plays d,2d,...,2^n d; pairing graph with ≤n edges on n+1 vertices has a tree component, bipartition forces D≥d. Upper bound: 2^(n+1) subset sums give gap ≤d, refined into equal pairs using ≤n cuts. Minor slack (r+s-2 vs r+s-1 cuts) is harmless.
